identity.name: Talon T. Cherry
identity.tagline: Time can only take the joy you never shared
identity.description: Official site of Talon Cherry, an Oregon-born singer-songwriter, poet, and memoirist now writing and recording from West Texas. Not affiliated with any tobacco brand.

identity.host_note: Built local. Hosted free via GitHub Pages.
identity.cookie_note: We use Google Analytics just to see if anyone is reading this, or if I'm shouting into the void.

home.mail_blurb: Notes, hellos, and honest mail. I’ll read what you send.
home.mail_success: Your letter has been dispatched into the mail bag. Thank you for writing.

social.title: Social
social.tagline: The songs live on YouTube. Come sit with them there.

music.title: The Campfire Radio Session
music.blurb: Click or turn the analog dial below to switch stations. Full curated audio broadcasts from the pines to the plains.
music.broadcast_note: Broadcasted from the desk by the window. Click knob to tune.

stations.title: Original Studio & Acoustic Sessions
stations.notes: Original songwriting capturing the transition from the crisp mountain pines of Oregon down into the wide-open skies of West Texas. Recorded live with an honest heart.

stations.title: Live Acoustic Covers Archive
stations.notes: Raw, stripped-down interpretations of timeless tracks. Just a mahogany acoustic guitar, live vocal stems, and an open window.

stations.title: Holiday & Seasonal Sessions
stations.notes: Warm acoustic renditions of classic holiday songs recorded for the winter season. Cozy fireside guitar arrangements and quiet reflections.
